functions.name: appendFloatFormatSpec
functions.notes: Assembles a printf-style float conversion tail: optional +/#, .* for non-hex styles, payload, then e/f/a/g suffix selected by flags & 260 and case by 0x4000; returns 1 when .* was written.

validation.comparison: Every style 0..300 x five flag sets, payload lengths 0..8 x four flag sets, embedded NUL and four destination placements compare return, destination bytes, stack pointer and complete memory hash.
limitations: Out-of-bounds pointers, memory growth and overlapping source/destination are not exercised.
Ledger: 252 server bodies recovered and 482 remain machine code.
